entries.source: Screenshots taken by this project with video/assets/captures/capture.mjs: the built GitHub Reskin extension, unpacked in a fresh logged-out Chromium profile, on public github.com pages (github.com/whoisaldo, the project owner; github.com/Alitleis123; github.com/torvalds; sidebandstudio/GitHub-Reskin at commit 1a67a05) and on the extension's own popup page. Each PNG has a JSON manifest beside it with URL, theme and source hash, extension commit, viewport, scroll, date and its own SHA-256.
